name: protected reduction
note: An 8:24 reduction with a slip clutch on the output. The other kind of clutch entirely from the one a driving ring engages: a 24-tooth gear with a friction centre that gives way above a force, so the 8t cannot be broken by winding the input against a stop. 24 is the only size the part is made in, which is why it sits on the output and not the input.
